newLayers.name: RPC and Security
newLayers.description: How the driver, executors and masters talk to each other and keep it safe: the RpcEnv and RpcEndpoint abstraction with its Netty implementation (dispatcher, inbox and outbox, message loops, stream manager), timeouts and addresses, plus the security helpers: encryption of IO streams, authentication of local sockets, delegation token providers and group mapping.

tour.title: RPC: endpoints, the dispatcher and the inbox
tour.description: Spark components talk through an RpcEnv. An RpcEndpoint receives messages and replies through an RpcCallContext; an RpcEndpointRef is the handle used to send or ask. In the Netty implementation NettyRpcEnv registers endpoints in the Dispatcher, which puts each incoming message in the endpoint's Inbox, processed by a MessageLoop on a thread pool; messages to remote endpoints go through an Outbox per address. RpcTimeout wraps the timeouts of asks.
